t: You're looking at Highpoint I, an apartment block in Highgate, built in the 1930s on one of the highest points in London. It was the first of two blocks on the site. The architect was Berthold Lubetkin, a Russian-born British designer who pioneered modernist architecture in Britain in the 1930s. The structure was designed by the engineer Ove Arup, and Kier built it. Lubetkin's other work includes the Penguin Pool at London Zoo, Finsbury Health Centre and the Spa Green Estate.
